messages:
abby: Heads-up — RC3 (tag: rc3-20260322) is built and pushed: ghcr.io/redwood/serve:rc3-20260322. Ready for preflight lift checks. Please ack if you can be on standby for the 23:00 UTC window.
sam: oncall tonight, I can cover 23:00 UTC. will run the telemetry dryrun at +10m after lift.
marta: I can do postdeploy smoke and release notes delta. quick ask: do we unfreeze the feature flags for the new routing logic or keep them off until canary metrics look stable?
abby: prefer keep flags off initially, we'll enable via staged flag within 5% increments after KV warm completes. Only exception if QA sees a blocking reg.
qa-bot: Preflight checklist: unit tests ✅, integration tests ✅, e2e flaky tests flagged (see link) -> tickets/RT-412. Telemetry coverage OK for latency and error-rate asserts.
deploy-bot: Promotion ready. Command queued: `/promote --artifact ghcr.io/redwood/serve:rc3-20260322 --env prod --window 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z --staged-steps 5,25,50,100 --health-check /healthz --timeout 600s`
sam: I want a rollback knob spelled out. Suggest: `kubectl set image deploy/serve serve=ghcr.io/redwood/serve:rc2-20260321 && sleep 30 && kubectl rollout status deploy/serve` as immediate rollback. Also add deploy-bot shortcut: `/rollback --tag rc2-20260321`
marta: added a short rollback playbook to the ticket: steps, who pings who, and a postmortem template. I also updated release notes: highlight routing opt-in behind flag, change in token billing rounding.
abby: Telemetry DRYRUN plan: sam runs a synthetic load for 5m at +10m, we validate p95 latency < 120ms and error-rate < 0.2%. If either threshold breached, abort and roll back.
sam: ack. I'll post results to this thread. also enabling deadman's toggle: deploy-bot will auto-revert if error-rate > 1% for 3 consecutive mins.
deploy-bot: Safety escrow created: escrow-id esc-20260322-01. Artifact pinned to escrow. Auto-revert policy configured: error_rate_threshold=1.0, consecutive_minutes=3, revert_to_tag=rc2-20260321.
abby: Final check — does the console docs reflect the new rollout knobs? marta?
marta: yes, docs updated and linked in release notes. Also added a small paragraph about KV warming requirement: run `curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/warm-kv?keys=popular` before step 5.
abby: ok launching the promote at 23:00. thanks team. :thumbsup:
sam: promote started at 23:00Z via deploy-bot. will monitor and post telemetry.
qa-bot: Post-deploy smoke checklist started. Running core flows now.
sam: Dryrun results at +10m: p95=115ms, error-rate=0.07%. looks good. moving to 25% staged step.
marta: 25% looks healthy, doc examples exercised, no regressions in routing. proceeding to 50%.
sam: 50% steady. no alarms. proceeding to full rollout.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: ghcr.io/redwood/serve:rc3-20260322 -> prod. Escrow esc-20260322-01 will be retained for 72h.
abby: release notes published and emailed to infra-subscribers. closing thread but keeping escrow open 72h. thanks everyone. :party:
